title: The land push step of the kb is named _tools/kbgit.py sync --push, so its land.step token is no longer kbgit.py-sync-push
goal: bl_land.land_push cuts an absolute path in the push command to its last part and keeps the program word of a relative one as before, so the kb's land.step token stays kbgit.py-sync-push for backlog.py ops, landings and kbmon

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_land; sys.exit(0 if bl_land.ops_token(bl_land.land_push()[0])=='kbgit.py-sync-push' else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-vmtfnkim review on 2026-10-26 (BG-zoaoahj4's change to land_push): the kb's backlog.json names land_push as the relative _tools/kbgit.py sync --push, which gave the label kbgit.py sync --push through Path(argv[0]).name; the cut now applies to absolute arguments only, so the ops token is _tools-kbgit.py-sync-push and the history, backlog.py landings, kbmon's land: step and backlog.md (which names kbgit.py-sync-push) disagree with the rows written from that commit on. Fix direction: keep the program's last part for argv[0] and cut other absolute arguments.
